ios.desc:
Stop endless scrolling, start watching! Find a movie everyone will agree on, fast.

Tired of spending more time searching than watching? Movie Night makes it easy to discover films your whole group will love. Simply swipe, match, and enjoy!

Why You'll Love It:

• Swipe to Match: Find the perfect movie effortlessly.
• Streaming Integration: See where to watch (Netflix, Prime Video etc.) and launch directly.
• Trailers: Watch trailers to get everyone excited.
• Community: Discover lists and reviews from fellow movie lovers.
• Staff Picks: Get inspired by our curated recommendations.
• Your Library: Create a personalized movie collection.
• Movie Details: Explore casting, synopses, and more.

Ready for a great movie night?

Download Movie Night now!

quotes.story_title: An app to pick movies with your partner or friends in a Tinder like way

quotes.text:
Hey guys! Me and my friends created iOS and Android apps to make the process of picking movies easier for people who struggle to do so in a conventional way. The idea was based on a tweet that got pretty popular on reddit.
To make use of the app you need it installed for you and your partner. You don't need to register or give us any of your personal info. You create a room, select filters (like genres, release dates and streaming services) and wait for your partner to join which is quite simple, just scan the QR-code that is generated when creating room. Every time you get a match the app lets you know.
